requirement: Telegram-compatible clients shall be able to connect to the server and exchange MTProto messages. The server shall acknowledge protocol requests to discard an RPC response.

The server shall support MTProto authorization-key and server-salt exchanges, subsequent encrypted sessions, and creation of new or additional client sessions. It shall support old-session removal and replacement following a connection reset. For future-salt requests, a count of zero shall default to 32, and the response may return fewer salts but shall not exceed the resulting requested count.

The server shall support registration and phone-number verification within its protocol flows. In the documented default or test setup without an external verifier, it shall accept the fixed verification code 12345. When an external verification service is enabled, that service's issued and validated code shall govern verification.

The Go-based server shall support Docker-based and manual build/install deployment with MySQL, Redis, etcd, Kafka, and MinIO as infrastructure dependencies. Deployments using the optional media-processing wrapper shall also provide FFmpeg and FFProbe.
